_instructions: Edit values below to update your portfolio. Save and refresh the page.

TERMINAL SECTION: Customize boot text, banner, prompt, and welcome message.

- prompt: The command prompt prefix (e.g. C:\Users\you> ).
SKILLS: Grouped by category. Add/remove categories freely.
EXPERIENCE: Array of jobs. Each shows as a timeline card.
PROJECTS: Array of projects. Set 'link' to a URL or null to hide the button.
